response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref), grp AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS fraction FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat), ranked AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, record_count, fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS rnk FROM grp) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, record_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, zoneref, insurstat
